split_policy.DEV: may be run repeatedly and used to tune candidate behavior; includes exposed regression cases
split_policy.HOLDOUT: embedded 30-case HOLDOUT is an exposed regression checkpoint, not blind evidence; blind claims require a separate closed registration satisfying holdout-policy.json
split_policy.OLD_V4_R1_HOLDOUT: retired because its proxy outputs were inspected and informed benchmark repair
split_policy.OLD_V3_HOLDOUT: retired because its outputs were inspected during benchmark review

execution_policy.BEHAVIOR_SIMULATION: all 100 cases; the eval-only candidate adapter injects simulation_fact_refs only on this lane and keeps effects disabled
execution_policy.PRODUCTION_CONTRACT: only effectively SUPPORTED cases after contract-reachability.json; materialize runtime_claim_refs through runtime-materialization.json, derive canonical dialogue/buying evidence through the production canonical-evidence helper from latest_customer_message, and build canonical Context V2 before candidate request builders; stale/integrity failures reject before provider; protected-looking responder text is guarded segment-by-segment against exact frozen claim scope; malformed claim scope/evidence mappings and canonical-evidence expectation mismatches reject instead of receiving defaults
execution_policy.QUALITY_EVALUATION: C2 owns rubric/scoring/evaluation; FIRST_CONTACT_FIXED is evaluated as Responder-only and ADAPTIVE_FOLLOWUP as Strategist + Responder from the candidate-recorded runtime lane; benchmark identity remains independent of candidate prompt revision; judge input hides case ID/split and keeps responder output out of strategist judge input
execution_policy.QUALITY_GATE: aggregate typed case outcomes against an explicit frozen expected-case population; partial populations or caller metadata that disagrees with the plan fail closed; scored call cardinality is derived from the evaluated candidate shape in the score (FIRST_CONTACT_FIXED = 1, ADAPTIVE_FOLLOWUP = 2), not from a caller-supplied call-shape label; production BLOCKED_BY_CONTRACT cases must be zero-call CONTRACT_SKIP, and expected pre-model rejects require zero provider calls
execution_policy.OWNER_SAFETY: route-map and capability matrix define mandatory probes; the observation gate rejects always-HUMAN positive probes and any provider/effect/persistence/outbox activity, but positive authorized-capability probes are not production evidence until a matching real capability port exists
execution_policy.SMOKE: select only production-supported cases after production-contract suite passes; operational effects remain disabled until separately authorized end-to-end testing

source_corpus.traceability: trace_examples are pattern provenance only; historical product/policy values are never factual authority

execution_blockers: Bind the C2 stage judge port to the owner-selected hash-pinned judge provider before recording provider-backed quality scores.
Connect positive OWNER/SAFETY capability probes to real authorized capability ports when those ports exist; do not substitute synthetic production capabilities.
